# Tiny Demo API

A minimal OpenAPI document used as golden-file input for oapidoc.

- **Release:** `v9.9.9`
- **API version:** `1.2.3`

## Servers

- `https://example.local/v1` — Local demo

## Endpoints

- [pets](endpoints/pets.md) — Pet endpoints.
- [shared](endpoints/shared.md) — Shared across resources.

## Schemas

- [Error](schemas/Error.md) — An error payload.
- [Pet](schemas/Pet.md) — A pet in the demo catalog (e.g. a dog).
- [PetList](schemas/PetList.md) — A list of pets.
